data.title: Amended Income Tax Assessment 2022 – Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf
data.summary: The Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf sent David Muster an amended income tax assessment (geänderter Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2022, replacing the earlier assessment of 14.06.2023 due to a corrected report from his employer. The income tax remains fixed at €6,918.00, so there is no back payment and no refund.
data.explanation: Your tax office corrected your 2022 income tax assessment because your employer sent an updated report, but the tax amount itself did not change, so you owe nothing extra and get no refund. You still have the right to formally object (Einspruch) if you disagree with anything in the notice, by the deadline shown, which is calculated from when the letter is considered delivered. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final as issued. Since no money changes hands, this is mainly for your records; consider professional advice only if you believe the figures are wrong.
